== Summary ==
Players Committee legacy virtual-card slip PDF ''Virtual Block 9: Republic At War'' (cover: official text as of 10 January 2014). This is the official <code>VirtualBlock9_1.pdf</code> that the Committee hosted at res.starwarsccg.org and that is cited on [[Virtual Block 9]].

* '''Date:''' 10 January 2014 (official text date on the cover)
* '''Pages:''' 13
